evidence.summary: DSH远程SSH插件，为开发运维用户统一管理主机、Web终端、文件传输、隧道与按选择器执行的集群命令，并提供六个模型工具。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

limitations: 定向核本子包manifest/bundle、host/client实际注册与GUI/API、工具到engine、pool/config/auth构造及exec/集群失败、PTY独立会话/重附着、SFTP和tunnel核心调用/清理、store和共享loopback/遥测；必要锁文件及固定ssh2默认主机key契约。未完整审所有认证/多跳/导入解析、SSH密码学、全UI、宿主工具授权与OS/远端进程策略，不执行目标。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

evidence.summary: ssh2 1.17.0官方固定版本README说明未设hostVerifier时默认自动接受主机key；本包构造未传该字段，锁文件此importer为1.17.0。非目标握手/攻击实验。
limitations: 依赖官方文档契约与目标源码配置的合并解释，不是实际已安装版本/握手行为验证；未执行目标或SSH2。
仅为本子包必要库契约，不把库当DSH插件或声称全认证/密码学审计。

findings.text: 为熟悉SSH的DSH用户集中远端排障/文件/隧道；验收真实主机及业务状态，不以连接或exit0代替。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
同home级store/engine连接GUI和六工具；alias池→ssh2→exec/集群，PTY独立连接并可重附着，SFTP/隧道各有生命周期。见[Q02](#research-q02)。

定向核本子包manifest/bundle、host/client实际注册与GUI/API、工具到engine、pool/config/auth构造及exec/集群失败、PTY独立会话/重附着、SFTP和tunnel核心调用/清理、store和共享loopback/遥测；必要锁文件及固定ssh2默认主机key契约。未完整审所有认证/多跳/导入解析、SSH密码学、全UI、宿主工具授权与OS/远端进程策略，不执行目标。
远端/网络/临时磁盘、模型与人工对账恢复成本分列；连接/stream限时、idle与workers不是总费用或副作用上限。表见[Q04](#research-q04)。
有SSH经验且有隔离测试机的用户，可用独立可弃置DSH_HOME、唯一测试alias和临时低权限key，保持无模型轮次，GUI执行一条审核后的只读命令；不用生产凭据、forwardAgent或ProxyCommand。身份/目标/结果、取消或存量资源不明时停操作并人工对账，勿重放写命令；有主机key pin、加密或文件沙箱硬要求时保持观察并用既有方案。见[Q04](#research-q04)。
配置和操作入口复用、局部生命周期有源码支持；净节时、主机key校验、完整取消和业务终态正确未实测/未保障。效果表见[Q04](#research-q04)。
单engine、池重连条件、配置变更失效、SFTP finally和独立PTY重附着可复用；取消与重试必须核caller，配置/路由撤下不当所有资源回滚。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
DSH配置/连接/GUI工具共享与可追踪逐主机结果有实际接线，alias变更清池/隧道、PTY重附着和SFTP channel释放有用；范围不扩成全运维平台。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
断线可重放，实际exec未将signal再给池，alias重连目标未冻结；工具文件不经workspace门卫，默认主机key未pin，配置禁用与完整资源停止不同。见[Q03](#research-q03)。
候选是受验证真实目标/配置版本绑定、取消前置和未知副作用结果对账；先比普通SSH作业ID/日志及几处上游补丁，不凭风险造独立需求。见[Q05](#research-q05)。
兼容宿主/Node、受控测试机与独立home/专用凭据是前提；key pin/路径沙箱等要求未满足者先观察。条件与遥测表见[Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)SSH/GUI/工具复用属小幅整合novelty9，非新方法18；[Q02](#research-q02)池/PTY/清理是局部接线机制8，未到副作用与目标正确性闭环15；[Q03](#research-q03)生命周期和caller核查可条件迁移10，但依赖宿主/SSH契约未到普适15；[Q04](#research-q04)入口集中简化8，权限/恢复手工仍重，未到11。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)比独立SSH工具主要少切入口workflow9，未改变协作分工18；[Q02](#research-q02)仍交付命令/文件/端口，逐host回报使delivery小幅8但不是业务验收单元15；[Q04](#research-q04)面向既有DSH/SSH人群GUI可达reach5，新增非运维群体未证，未到10；[Q02](#research-q02)同alias池让exec/SFTP/隧道复用连接，并有条件idle回收，改变重复建连的资源组织，经济机制给小幅4；仍是既有SSH操作接线且PTY独立、pinned/恢复需维护，未到成本结构或服务方式更明显改变的8。净TCO、节时和付费增量未知，另列[Q04](#research-q04)，不以未知推0或当实测收益。

recommendation.reason: 有SSH经验且有本机隔离VM或受控隔离链路测试机的用户，可在独立可弃置DSH_HOME只配置一个测试alias和临时低权限key，不启动模型轮次，用GUI确认一条只读命令。它让主机配置、连接和逐主机结果共用入口，但断线重放、实际取消caller、未pin主机key及存量资源边界要求人工核真实目标/结果，提示隐藏不等撤工具。身份或结果不明、错误/超时、清理不符时停操作且不重放写命令，退回既有SSH方案对账并撤测试凭据，有主机key pin或路径沙箱硬要求者先观察。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)DSH内复用SSH配置与核远端结果任务明确，超泛远程入口15；频率/实际用户收益未测，未到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)同store/engine、多入口和逐host结果超薄GUI6；[Q03](#research-q03)目标/信任/取消和结果恢复仍需人工，不能替成熟SSH策略，未到19。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)真实注册/exec caller、重试与取消反证及固定依赖key默认契约超README/片段6；未跑SSH/断链/配置变更或兼容实验，未到19。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)真实远端/host路径、凭据和未知副作用恢复负担使其低于10；[Q04](#research-q04)独立home、隔离测试机、一次性key且无模型轮次的只读小样可控，非0分不可接受。

publication.summaries.text: DSH远程SSH插件，为开发运维用户统一管理主机、Web终端、文件传输、隧道与按选择器执行的集群命令，并提供六个模型工具。

items.界面: 原生主机管理、Web PTY、传输/隧道/集群面板
items.Host 路由: 受直接loopback限制的SSH HTTP/WS端点

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 用途 | 条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 主机配置与GUI | 共用alias与连接配置、导入入口 | 同home共用；非逐会话主机授权 |
| exec/cluster | 命令与逐host结果、非空selector | broken可重放；非业务事务/目标冻结 |
| Web PTY | 交互shell与重附着 | 独立连接；detach不是立即停止 |
| SFTP | GUI staging或工具本机/远端文件 | 工具host任意路径，无整批回滚保证 |
| 本地隧道 | 127.0.0.1转发远端服务 | 长连接/pinned需显式清理 |

publication.advice.text: 有SSH经验且有隔离测试机的用户，可用独立可弃置DSH_HOME、唯一测试alias和临时低权限key，保持无模型轮次，GUI执行一条审核后的只读命令；不用生产凭据、forwardAgent或ProxyCommand。身份/目标/结果、取消或存量资源不明时停操作并人工对账，勿重放写命令；有主机key pin、加密或文件沙箱硬要求时保持观察并用既有方案。见[Q04](#research-q04)。

      "path": "packages/dsh-ssh/README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-ssh · Web SSH Terminal, SFTP Transfer & Remote Operations for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@linxin666/dsh-ssh?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Version\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.3-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54\" alt=\"DSH\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>Remote Linux Server Operations & Web SSH Suite for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)</strong><br>\n  <em>xterm.js Web Terminal · Visual SFTP Transfer · Port Forwarding Tunnels · Cluster Execution · 6 Agent Tools</em>\n</p>\n\nA dedicated remote Linux server operations and cluster management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and official desktop client: in-process persistent connection pool, Web GUI host inventory management, xterm.js terminal, visual SFTP file transfer, port forwarding tunnels, and 6 dedicated agent tools implemented on top of official NPM SDKs without modifying DSH core source code.\n\n## Capabilities\n\n| Capability | Description |\n| --- | --- |\n| Host management | CRUD, search, connection test; collapsible grouping by environment / tags with per-group batch test; config stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json`; supports key / password / ssh-agent auth (OpenSSH agent, with Pageant still selectable on Windows), passphrase keys, ProxyJump jump hosts (multi-level) and OpenSSH `ProxyCommand` transports (bastion clients) |\n| Config import | One-click parse of a standard `~/.ssh/config` (Host/HostName/User/Port/IdentityFile/IdentityAgent/ForwardAgent/ProxyJump/ProxyCommand, `Include` files, blocks without HostName); `ForwardAgent yes|true|on` imports as enabled and `no|false|off` (or no directive) as disabled; skipped blocks are listed with their reason (wildcard pattern, existing alias, Match block, invalid fields) |\n| Persistent connection pool | Reuses a long-lived connection per host (opposite of the ssh-skill daemon), automatically disconnects after 30 minutes idle, auto-reconnects on disconnect (up to 3 times) |\n| Agent forwarding | Opt-in per host through the `forwardAgent` flag (`ssh -A`); the form has an \"Enable agent forwarding\" checkbox, the host list shows an agent-forwarding badge for enabled hosts, and `ssh_list` reports `forwardAgent` with a forward column in its table. The endpoint is the host's configured agent path, otherwise `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, otherwise the native OpenSSH named pipe (`\\\\.\\pipe\\openssh-ssh-agent`) on Windows; a host with no local endpoint fails with an explicit error instead of connecting without forwarding. A server that refuses the request (`AllowAgentForwarding no`) surfaces its own error and is never downgraded to a silent non-forwarded session. The flag never touches the stored profile when it is off |\n| Command execution | exec with a timeout (default 60s), stdout/stderr separated, output truncation guard (2MB) |\n| Web terminal | xterm.js + WebSocket PTY terminal, auto-sizing, real-time output; the panel holds several terminal tabs, each with its own host PTY — switch, close one at a time, run several tabs against the same host, and the \"+\" control opens another tab on the host the toolbar shows |\n| File transfer | SFTP upload (browser file picker, NDJSON progress stream), download (progress bar + browser save); remote directory browsing |\n| Port forwarding | Local port-forward tunnel (listens on 127.0.0.1 only) to reach a remote database / intranet service; list / stop supported |\n| Cluster execution | One command run concurrently across many hosts (filter by alias / environment / tag, default concurrency 8) |\n| Agent tools | `ssh_list` / `ssh_exec` / `ssh_upload` / `ssh_download` / `ssh_tunnel` / `ssh_cluster`; GUI and Agent share the same host config |\n\nThe panel loads its contents on first open. Closing and reopening it preserves the selected tab, form drafts and every terminal tab. A terminal tab that is not on screen keeps its remote shell in the Host: the view detaches, and returning to the tab reattaches by session id and replays the host's scrollback into the single xterm. A remote shell that exits keeps its tab and its last screen instead of vanishing, and a tab closed in the background is only removed once the Host confirms the close — a close that cannot be delivered keeps the tab and says so. The tunnel list refreshes every five seconds while its tab, panel and browser page are visible; automatic reads pause when hidden, resume immediately on return, and do not overlap slow reads. Port forwarding itself continues in the Host.\n\n## Security model\n\n- All `/api/dsh-ssh/*` routes are loopback-only (with same-origin checks) — the interfaces that execute commands against remote servers are not exposed to the LAN.\n- Passwords / key passphrases are stored in plain text in `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json`, file mode 0600, directory 0700 (the same trust model as ssh-skill writing passwords into ssh-config comments).\n- ssh-agent auth stores only the agent socket path (or the special value `pageant`); it never reads or stores private-key material. An empty agent path is not a secret and is always saved: it means auto-detect (`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, then the native OpenSSH named pipe on Windows), so switching a host to SSH Agent takes effect even with the field left blank.\n- Agent forwarding is opt-in per host and off by default. With `forwardAgent` enabled, every exec and PTY session on that host asks the server for `auth-agent-req@openssh.com`, which means the remote host can authenticate as this machine with your local keys. Enable it only for hosts you trust, and remember every session on such a host can use the forwarded agent. When no agent endpoint resolves (the configured agent path, `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, the native OpenSSH named pipe on Windows) the connection fails instead of forwarding nothing, and a server that refuses the request surfaces its error exactly as it comes back.\n- Tunnels only listen on `127.0.0.1`.\n- Deleting a host or changing its connection fields (host / port / user / auth / proxyJump / proxyCommand / forwardAgent) immediately closes that alias's pooled connection and tunnels; later operations reconnect with the new configuration and never reuse a connection authenticated with the old credentials.\n- When the SSH connection behind a tunnel drops, the tunnel retires itself: the local port stops accepting, the tunnel leaves the list, and the connection that arrives during the drop is closed without traffic instead of interrupting the host process.\n- A `proxyCommand` value is a shell command executed by the DSH host process with its privileges — exactly the trust `ssh(1)` gives the same line in `~/.ssh/config`. It can only come from the user's own 0600 store file: the Agent cannot create or edit hosts, and `ssh_list` reports only whether a host has one, never the command text.\n- Before the Agent uses a tool, the host must first be configured in the GUI (or imported from ~/.ssh/config).\n- `ssh_upload` / `ssh_download` read/write arbitrary local paths on this machine with host-process privileges (not through the bash sandbox) — same host-local-path semantics as ssh-skill, be aware of that permission surface.\n- Agent transfer tools move files only between this machine and a remote SSH host; local-file reads and writes must use the local file tools (read / write / edit / bash), never the `ssh_*` tools.\n- The remote output of exec / cluster is returned verbatim (not sanitized); a command like `env` may bring secrets from the remote environment back into the conversation log.\n\n## Install\n\nInstall the family aggregate package `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` (all plugins and skins in one) or this plugin alone:\n\n```sh\n### From npm (recommended)\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-ssh@latest\n\n### From the repository (development)\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\npnpm install && pnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-ssh\n\n```\n\nAfter installing, **restart `dsh web`**: a \"SSH\" entry appears in the sidebar; the plugin description is injected into the Agent prompt automatically.\n\n## Configuration\n\nThe settings panel (plugin config) toggles `announceToAgent` (whether to announce the plugin to the Agent; off by default so system prompts stay clean) and `enabled` (master switch), sets `terminalFontFamily` (the web terminal font; empty defers to the CSS chain: `--dsh-ssh-terminal-font` → the official `--ds-font-family-code` token → the built-in monospace stack), and sets `connectTimeoutMs` (the shared ceiling for TCP connect, SSH key exchange and user authentication, default 30000 ms, allowed 1000-600000). Raise `connectTimeoutMs` on hosts whose authentication is slow (for example PAM or LDAP behind a distant directory service): every connection entry point — `ssh_exec`, the web terminal, SFTP transfers, tunnels and cluster runs — reads it, while the `timeoutMs` argument of `ssh_exec` / `ssh_cluster` only bounds the remote command once the connection is ready. The terminal font is fixed in the xterm constructor, so a plain stylesheet cannot override it; to render powerline / Nerd Font glyphs, enter a Nerd Font stack here (e.g. `\"SauceCodePro Nerd Font\", monospace`). Changes re-apply to open terminals live, no reconnect needed; a new `connectTimeoutMs` applies to connections opened afterwards, and pooled connections are unaffected until they reconnect.\n\n## Data\n\n- Host config: `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` (versioned JSON, atomic write)\n- Transfer staging: `os.tmpdir()/dsh-ssh-uploads/` (0700 directory, 0600 in-flight files)\n\n## Development\n\n```sh\npnpm install --filter @linxin666/dsh-ssh...\npnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-ssh test    # unit tests: store + engine (embedded ssh2 Server + real sshd)\npnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-ssh build   # tsc types + tsdown dual-half artifacts\n```\n\n## Known limitations\n\n- The remote target path of an upload must be an absolute path (relative paths are rejected).\n- Download does not support a whole directory yet (download files individually); upload supports recursive directories (walks the local directory and transfers file by file).\n- exec auto-reconnect on disconnect (up to 3 times) may re-execute non-idempotent commands — watch out for side effects on long commands.\n- A ProxyJump hop is either a host alias configured in this plugin or an OpenSSH `[user@]host[:port]` address; an address hop has no stored credentials, so it reuses the target host's authentication (configure a host entry when the hop needs its own).\n- `proxyCommand` and `proxyJump` cannot be combined on one host (OpenSSH resolves them by \"whichever appears first in the config\"; a stored entry has no order, so the plugin rejects the pair), and only the first hop of a chain may declare a ProxyCommand.\n- A ProxyCommand is executed through the user's shell, so it inherits the DSH process's `PATH` and environment. On Windows the shell is killed without its process group, so a client it spawned may outlive the transport.\n- The ssh_config import expands `Include` (globs, `~`, several pathnames, relative to the config directory) but not environment variables or `%` tokens, and a multi-pattern `Host a b` line still imports only its first pattern.\n- Resume (broken-transfer continuation) is not implemented yet.\n- The transfer of Agent tools is a host-machine local path (same semantics as ssh-skill).\n\n## Telemetry\n\nThe browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC day to dsh-market.com: a random localStorage id plus this package's name, nothing else. 分支后自动触发持续集成部署。\n\n创意工坊旨在建立开放透明的社区生态，方便开发者分享作品并让用户自由选择所需扩展。\n\n## 功能插件\n\n### 任务看板（Task Board · 企业级后台长程执行引擎与多 Agent 自动化流水线）\n\n通过侧边栏“任务看板”进入。任务看板不仅仅是一个可视化卡片界面，更是 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端中的**宿主权威后台长程执行与多 Agent 自动化调度引擎**。任务按“待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败”五列进行全生命周期管理，以 Schema v6 事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、分发、团队协作、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化：\n\n- **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。\n- **多 Agent 树状级联并发与原生 Agent Teams 团队编排**：复杂工程目标可自由拆解为多层树状子任务（支持 1~3 层深度，内置环路与深度护栏）。**级联执行模式**通过受控准入队列（runLaunchWidth）并发派生多个独立智能体会话，自动跳过已在完成列的子任务，任一子任务失败自适应收拢整树状态；**原生 Agent Teams 模式**深度对接官方团队服务，启动专属 Team Lead 会话并在其内部为每个子任务动态孵化专属 Teammate，协同工具跨智能体联动，实现真正意义上的多智能体团队协同作战。\n- **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。\n- **全自动 GitHub Issue-to-PR 闭环研发流**：搭配官方扩展（`dsh-client-ui-task-board-github`），实现任务看板与 GitHub Issues / PR 状态的实时双向深度同步。远端 Issue 自动进入看板流水线驱动 Agent 读取需求、定位代码、修复 Bug 并运行测试，验收交付后全自动创建 GitHub Pull Request 并绑定 Issue 关联，PR 合并后自动关闭 Issue，打造全天候无人值守的开源与企业 Issue 自动化修复交付管线。\n- **长程目标驱动、会话持久化与冻结交接包（Freeze Handover）**：任务支持武装内置 `/goal` 引擎进行多轮自主续跑；周期性任务可开启会话复用，保留完整上下文记忆；支持通过 `<<<FREEZE` 协议将会话上下文一键冻结为包含“目标/进度/下一步”的结构化快照，并绑定工作区、预设与权限三元组，接手 Agent 瞬间无缝继承前序成果，同时内置提示词注入防御与来源审计。\n- **企业级权限基线、安全确认门与消费熔断保护**：任务可细粒度钉住工作区、Agent 预设、沙箱权限、执行模型与推理思考强度，钉子校验失败即 自身查看看板、分解子任务、编排流水线与自动化调度的全套能力；同时支持通过 `record-external-outcome` 统一登记在 Claude Code、Codex 等外部工具中完成的工作，让异构开发流统一汇总至一张看板。\n\n| 多列看板与智能体协作 | 后台定时调度与参数配置 |\n| --- | --- |\n| ![DeepSeek Harness 任务看板界面 — AI 运行时与高效调度引擎）\n\n在新建会话输入框左侧通过专属老虎机拨杆切换，或在“设置 > Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验：\n\n- **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。\n- **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。\n- **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。\n- **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。\n- **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。\n- **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。\n\n详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 移动端远程控制（Mobile Remote · 手机访问与跨设备触控优化）\n\n通过侧边栏底部的手机图标打开设备配对面板。使用手机扫码或复制链接配对后，手机浏览器将直接载入官方 Web GUI，并自动激活移动端触控交互层：轻触鲸鱼图标唤出侧边栏、支持手势左滑收起与右滑展开、长按会话项目呼出操作菜单、软键盘 Enter 键仅用于换行、输入框采用 16px 字体防止页面聚焦缩放。适合桌面屏幕的扩展面板（如 SSH 终端、任务看板、Git 图谱等）在手机端自动隐藏，聚焦于会话管理、模型切换、思考强度调整与消息收发，多端实时共享完整上下文状态。\n\n同一配对通道同样支持另一台 PC |\n\n### 会话归档管理（Session Archive Manager · 全文检索与生命周期策略）\n\n会话归档管理（`dsh-session-archive`）是专为解决大量长短期会话堆积而设计的集中管理模块，随全家桶安装生效：\n\n- **集中检索与状态筛选**：统一呈现活跃会话、已归档会话、空白会话、子代理派生会话以及无工作区会话，支持按标题、工作区、状态及会话 ID 进行关键词搜索与多维排序；\n- **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删；\n- **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。\n\n删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 更多插件（More Plugins）\n\n- **Skill 中心**（`dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer`）：按来源集中查看与管理已加载的 agent skills，支持按名称与功能描述实时搜索过滤，多工作区独立呈现，支持一键启停与删除。\n- **插件管理器**（`dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager`）：基于官方 host 接口从 npm 或 蓝色幻想是随皮肤插件内置的默认主题：深邃的靛蓝色调贯穿全局，搭配半透明毛玻璃面板与定制鲸鱼插画，在暗色模式下具有优秀的视觉沉浸感。其他精美皮肤与 Wallpaper Engine 动态壁纸由皮肤插件统一管理，可直接在[创意工坊](https://dsh-market.com)在线预览、试穿与一键安装。\n\n![DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤 — Blue Fantasy 暗黑沉浸风格预览](docs/screenshots/17-skin-blue-fantasy-dark.png)\n\n## 快速上手\n\n### 系统要求\n\n- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness 且 `dsh web` 可正常启动。\n- npm 安装方式无需额外环境；若从源码仓库构建，需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 环境。\n\n### 三步上手（npm [docs/plugins.md](docs/plugins.md)。\n\n### 安装排障\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>展开查看常见安装与构建排障方案</strong></summary>\n\n<br>\n\n> **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。\n\n> **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：这三项审批必须在首次 add 之前就位。正确顺序是重置 profile（官方 `--from-default-profile web`）或换新 profile，把 `cloudflared`、`cpu-features`、`ssh2` 写进 `<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds`，再执行 add。装失败后补审批重跑会 exit 0，但 `dsh.profile.bundles` 仍无该行：静默半挂载，重跑修不回来。已带审批的存量 profile 升级不受影响。\n\n> **pnpm 11 发布时间门禁问题**：在包版本发布后的短时间内，pnpm 11 的默认安全策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）可能会尝试回退拉取旧版本。建议在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中排除相关命名空间以确保获取最新版本：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> minimumReleaseAgeExclude:\n>   - '@linxin666/*'\n> ```\n\n</details>\n\n## 兼容性与运行环境\n\ndsh-web 针对主流操作系统、现代化浏览器及网络拓扑进行了深度工程调优与兼容性保障：\n\n| 维度 | 支持范围与技术规格 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 宿主运行环境 | DeepSeek Harness CLI (`dsh web`)、官方桌面客户端（DeepSeek Harness Desktop） |\n| 操作系统 | macOS (Apple Silicon M 系列 & Intel 芯片)、Windows 10/11 (含 WSL2)、Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch, CentOS 等) |\n| 浏览器与设备 | 桌面浏览器 (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox)；移动端现代浏览器 (iOS Safari, Android Chrome 等) |\n| 网络连接架构 | 本机环回访问 (127.0.0.1)、局域网多设备互联 (LAN)、公网隧道安全穿透 (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale, FRP, Nginx 反向代理) |\n| 模型供应商覆盖 | DeepSeek 官方通道与满血模型、OpenAI (GPT-4o 等)、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、Kimi (Moonshot)、GLM (智谱)、MiniMax、Ollama 本地大模型、SiliconFlow 等 |\n| 运行时依赖 | npm 方式安装无特殊环境依赖；源码编译需 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm >= 9 |\n\n## 常见问题\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>安装重启后，侧边栏未显示插件入口？</strong></summary>\n\n请首先检查插件是否正确安装至 `web` profile（命令需包含 `--profile web`），并通过 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 验证配置层是否已成功挂载。注意仅刷新网页无法加载新模块，必须彻底重启 `dsh web` 后端服务进程。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>定时任务为何未能按时触发执行？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，无需保持前端浏览器页面打开。若宿主进程退出、系统关机或整机进入深度睡眠，错过的触发时间点将遵循跳过策略处理，不执行回填补跑；若任务到达触发点时上一轮仍在运行，会自动顺延至下一个周期。若需要允许息屏但防止主机自动睡眠，可开启任务看板自带的电源保护选项。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>手机端配对后为何没有收到流式推送？</strong></summary>\n\n流式推送走官方 WebSocket 通道，配对后经门控的 `/remote` 代理转发。隧道中断期间更新暂停，通道恢复后继续，无需重新配对；更新节奏的差异来自远程链路的广域网往返延迟。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>试穿主题皮肤不满意如何还原？</strong></summary>\n\n皮肤面板提供免落盘试穿功能：点击试穿即刻在当前界面生效预览，离开面板或关闭预览会自动恢复初始外观；只有显式点击“应用”按钮才会将主题配置写入磁盘，可放心预览各类主题。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>是否可以仅使用主题皮肤或某个单一插件？</strong></summary>\n\n完全支持。若仅需要视觉定制，直接安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center` 即可；若仅需特定功能，参考“单独安装某个插件”章节直接安装对应 npm 包即可。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>已安装全家桶的前提下，能否额外独立安装某个子插件？</strong></summary>\n\n可以。聚合包内部的插件注册标识均统一带有 `web-ui-` 前缀（例如 `web-ui-usage`），与独立包的原生标识（如 `usage`）相互独立，不会产生 loader entry 重复冲突。宿主服务对同类插件会自动去重。通常情况下安装全家桶即可满足完整需求，无需重复安装单个子包。\n\n</details>\n\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何通过手机或平板远程访问 DeepSeek Harness？是否必须在同一 Wi-Fi 下？</strong></summary>\n\n手机远程访问基于配对令牌安全门控。若手机与运行 DSH 的电脑处于同一局域网（Wi-Fi），电脑端点击侧边栏手机图标弹出二维码，手机直接扫码即可打开完整的移动端交互界面。若需要公网跨网络访问（例如在户外使用移动蜂窝网络访问家中电脑），可搭配 Cloudflare Tunnel（例如 cloudflared）或 Tailscale 将 DSH 端口穿透至公网，手机打开公网链接配对访问即可，通信全程走鉴权通道，未配对请求将被严格拦截。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>关闭浏览器或电脑休眠后，DeepSeek 的定时任务还会继续运行吗？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，关闭浏览器标签页不影响定时任务的触发与执行。但如果整机进入深度睡眠或关机，宿主进程将暂停运行，离线期间错过的触发点会遵循跳过策略处理。若希望保持无人值守后台自动化，可在任务看板设置中开启“电源保护”选项，该选项会阻止系统因空闲进入休眠（允许显示器正常熄灭），确保定时任务准时触发。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何查看和监控 DeepSeek 及其他模型 API 的 Token 消耗与账户余额？</strong></summary>\n\n安装使用统计插件后，在“设置 > 使用统计”面板中可查看按日汇总的输入、输出与缓存 Token 数量，支持按模型细分查看 30 天消费趋势。针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费估算；若配置了支持查询余额的供应商 API，插件可定时拉取当前账户剩余额度与重置周期。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>多个 AI 智能体（Agent）并发编码时，如何避免 Git 分支和代码冲突？</strong></summary>\n\n直接在单一 Git 工作区并发运行多个智能体容易导致代码互相覆盖。使用全家桶内置的 Git 图谱插件，可以在新建会话时自动或手动创建独立的 Git Worktree。每个智能体会话在各自专属的分支和物理目录中独立运行、提交修改，彻底隔绝主工作区文件，开发完成后可在图谱面板中清晰比对并合并分支。\n\n</details>\n\n## 已知限制\n\n- 任务看板由后端 Host 进程统一调度，关闭前端标签页不影响任务执行；但若宿主进程停止或操作系统关机睡眠，处于离线期间的触发点将直接跳过不补跑。可选的电源保护仅阻止系统闲置睡眠，无法阻止用户主动合盖、手动休眠或电源切断，技术细节见 [dsh-task-board README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)。\n- SSH 凭据（密码与私钥口令）保存在本地 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 文件中（文件权限为 0600）；在网络中断重连时可能重新发送非幂等命令，终端输出保持原样返回不执行脱敏，安全规范见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)。\n- 移动端流式输出经隧道或固定域名中继转发，广域网往返延迟叠加在每次更新上；固定域名中继比裸快速隧道多一跳，两者都可用。\n- 从源码构建全仓需要 Node.js >= 22 与 pnpm 工具链，直接从 npm 安装不受此限制。\n\n## 社区\n\n欢迎加入社区交流群，与开发者及其他用户探讨使用技巧、反馈使用问题或提出新功能建议。\n\n扫描下方二维码加入“DSH Web 交流群”：\n\n<img src=\"docs/community-center.jpg\" alt=\"DeepSeek Harness       "content": "/**\n * Native panel registration for the SSH panel.\n *\n * The panel is an official-style center-column page, not a DOM takeover: it\n * contributes a row into the sidebar shell's own global panel list\n * (`sidebar.panellist`) and its page into the layout's keyed `main` slot. The\n * shell then owns the row box, the label, the active highlight, the collapsed\n * rail and the panel switch, exactly as it does for the shipped Plugins and\n * Schedule pages and for the task board and the skill center.\n *\n * Both registrations go through `ctx.slots.inject`, which fires only once the\n * owning shell entry has declared the seat: load order between this plugin and\n * ui-layout / ui-sidebar therefore does not matter, and neither does a shell\n * that cannot serve the seats (the callback simply never runs).\n *\n * The terminal's PTY shell lives on the host and outlives this page (see\n * engine/terminal-sessions.ts), so the layout unmounting a deselected page\n * costs the view its xterm instance, not the remote session: the terminal tab\n * reattaches by session id when the page mounts again.\n *\n * @module @linxin666/dsh-client-ssh/client\n */\nimport type { Context as ClientContext } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/client'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar/client'\nimport type { SshApi } from './api.ts'\nimport { SSH_PANEL_ID, type PanelController } from './panel/controller.ts'\nimport { tt, type TerminalFontSource } from './panel/helpers.ts'\nimport { SshPanel } from './panel/SshPanel.tsx'\nimport css from './panel/panel.module.css'\n\n/** The panel id shared by the sidebar row and the main-slot occupant. */\nexport { SSH_PANEL_ID }\n\n/** Row order among the shell's global panel rows (Plugins 0, Schedule 10, board 20, skill center 30). */\nconst PANEL_ORDER = 40\n\n/**\n * The sidebar row glyph the shell asks for at its own size and active state.\n * The shell owns the button, label, tooltip and rail geometry; active: boolean }): React.ReactElement {\n  return (\n    <svg\n      data-dsh-panel-entry={SSH_PANEL_ID}\n      viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\"\n      width={size}\n      height={size}\n      fill=\"none\"\n      stroke=\"currentColor\"\n      strokeWidth=\"1.5\"\n      strokeLinecap=\"round\"\n      strokeLinejoin=\"round\"\n      aria-hidden=\"true\"\n    >\n      <rect x=\"1.75\" y=\"2.25\" width=\"12.5\" height=\"11.5\" rx=\"1.75\" />\n      <path d=\"M4.25 5.25l2.75 2.75-2.75 2.75\" />\n      <path d=\"M8.5 10.75h3.25\" />\n    </svg>\n  )\n}\n\n/**\n * The main-slot page. the framework main-slot share plus this entry's injected face.\n * @returns the SSH panel page.\n */\nexport function SshPanelPage({ controller, api, terminalFont }: {\n  controller: PanelController\n  api: SshApi\n  terminalFont?: TerminalFontSource\n}): React.ReactElement {\n  return (\n    <div className={css.view} data-dsh-ssh-view=\"\" data-dsh-plugin=\"ssh\">\n      <SshPanel controller={controller} api={api} terminalFont={terminalFont} />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n/** The injected face both registrations receive. */\ninterface PanelFace {\n  controller: PanelController\n  api: SshApi\n  terminalFont?: TerminalFontSource\n}\n\n/**\n * Register the SSH panel's sidebar row and center-column page.\n *\n * Both seats are declared by shell plugins this package does not depend on at\n * runtime, so each registration is wrapped in `ctx.slots.inject`: the callback\n * runs only after the owning entry declares the seat, and a shell that never\n * declares it leaves the panel simply absent instead of failing boot.\n * @param ctx - Do not edit this copy; edit the shared source and run \"node scripts/sync-shared.mjs\".\n/**\n * Anonymous install telemetry shared by the DSH Web UI family plugins.\n *\n * Once per UTC day per browser, each wired plugin sends one heartbeat to\n * the dsh-market edge API listing its package name (and version when known).\n * The payload carries no conversation data and no identifiers beyond a random\n * UUID generated in localStorage; the server hashes it with a deployment salt\n * before storage and never persists IP addresses. Undefined in dev/test builds.\ndeclare const __DSH_PKG_VERSION__: string | undefined\n\n/** The building package's version, when the bundle carries it. */\nfunction bakedVersion(): string | undefined {\n  try {\n    return typeof __DSH_PKG_VERSION__ === 'string' && __DSH_PKG_VERSION__ !== ''\n      ? __DSH_PKG_VERSION__\n      : undefined\n  } catch {\n    return undefined\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether the user switched the family-wide opt-out on (reads storage only). */\nexport function isTelemetryOptedOut(): boolean {\n  try {\n    return localStorage.getItem(TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY) === '1'\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable: there is no stored opt-out to honour.\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\n/** Turn the family-wide opt-out on or off (writing '1' / removing the key); Owns the pool, tunnels, and all operations. A pooled connection\n   * keeps serving until it reconnects, because the ceiling governs the\n   * connect path only.\n   */\n  setConnectTimeout(timeoutMs: number): void {\n    this.opts.connectTimeoutMs = timeoutMs\n  }\n\n  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- config\n\n  /** Secret-free host list (filtered by the optional query). */\n  list(query?: string): SshHostSummary[] {\n    const needle = query?.trim().toLowerCase()\n    return this.store.list()\n      .filter(entry => needle === undefined || needle === ''\n        || entry.alias.toLowerCase().includes(needle)\n        || (entry.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(needle)\n        || entry.host.toLowerCase().includes(needle)\n        || entry.tags.some(tag => tag.toLowerCase().includes(needle)))\n      .map(entry => this.store.summarize(entry))\n  }\n\n  /** One host summary by alias. */\n  find(alias: string): SshHostSummary | undefined {\n    const entry = this.store.find(alias)\n    return entry === undefined ? undefined : this.store.summarize(entry)\n  }\n\n  // ------------------------------------------------------------ exec\n\n  /** Run one command on `alias` (reusing the pooled connection). */\n  async exec(alias: string, command: string, timeoutMs?: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ExecResult> {\n    return execCommand(this, alias, command, timeoutMs, signal)\n  }\n\n  /** Run one command against many hosts concurrently. */\n  async cluster(options: {\n    command: string\n    aliases?: string[]\n    environment?: string\n    tags?: string[]\n    timeoutMs?: number\n    maxWorkers?: number\n    signal?: AbortSignal\n  }): Promise<ClusterResult[]> {\n    return cluster(this, options)\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------- shell\n\n  /** Open a PTY shell session for the web terminal (standalone connection). */\n  async openShell(\n    alias: string,\n    size: { cols: number; rows: number },\n    onKeyboardInteractive?: KeyboardInteractiveHandler,\n  ): Promise<ShellSession> {\n    return openShell(this, alias, size, onKeyboardInteractive)\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------- sftp\n\n  /** Upload one local file (or directory tree) to a remote path. */\n  async upload(alias: string, localPath: string, remotePath: string, recursive: boolean, onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void): Promise<{ bytes: number;       "content": "/**\n * Cluster execution: run one command concurrently across selected hosts; the\n * caller must provide at least one non-empty aliases / environment / tags filter.\n */\n\nimport type { ClusterResult } from '../protocol.ts'\nimport { execCommand, type PoolEngine } from './connection-pool.ts'\n\ninterface ClusterOptions {\n  command: string\n  aliases?: string[]\n  environment?: string\n  tags?: string[]\n  timeoutMs?: number\n  maxWorkers?: number\n  /** Caller cancellation, forwarded to every host's command. */\n  signal?: AbortSignal\n}\n\n/** Run one command against many hosts concurrently. */\nexport async function cluster(engine: PoolEngine, options: ClusterOptions): Promise<ClusterResult[]> {\n  const hasAliases = Array.isArray(options.aliases) && options.aliases.some(alias => typeof alias === 'string' && alias.trim() !== '')\n  const hasEnvironment = typeof options.environment === 'string' && options.environment.trim() !== ''\n  const hasTags = Array.isArray(options.tags) && options.tags.some(tag => typeof tag === 'string' && tag.trim() !== '')\n  if (!hasAliases && !hasEnvironment && !hasTags) {\n    throw new Error('ssh_cluster requires aliases, environment, or tags to limit the target set')\n  }\n\n  let targets = engine.store.list()\n  if (options.aliases !== undefined && options.aliases.length > 0) {\n    targets = targets.filter(entry => options.aliases!.includes(entry.alias))\n  }\n  if (options.environment !== undefined && options.environment !== '') {\n    targets = targets.filter(entry => entry.environment === options.environment)\n  }\n  if (options.tags !== undefined && options.tags.length > 0) {\n    // ALL semantics (matches the ssh_cluster tool description).\n    targets = targets.filter(entry => options.maxWorkers < 1)) {\n    throw new Error('maxWorkers must be a positive integer')\n  }\n  const workers = Math.min(engine.opts.defaultMaxWorkers, options.maxWorkers ?? engine.opts.defaultMaxWorkers, targets.length)\n  const results: ClusterResult[] = []\n  const queue = [...targets]\n  const run = async (): Promise<void> => {\n    while (queue.length > 0) {\n      const entry = queue.shift()!\n      try {\n        const result = await execCommand(engine, entry.alias, options.command, options.timeoutMs, options.signal)\n        results.push({ alias: entry.alias, results.push({ alias: entry.alias, ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: workers }, () => run()))\n  return results\n}"

      "content": "/**\n * Connection pool: per-alias persistent ssh2 connections with multi-hop jump\n * support, the acquire / dispose / sweep lifecycle, and the pooled exec path.\n */\n\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport type { Duplex } from 'node:stream'\nimport { Client, type ConnectConfig } from 'ssh2'\nimport type { ExecResult, SshHostEntry } from '../protocol.ts'\nimport { expandHome, normalizeAgentPath, type HostStore } from '../store.ts'\nimport { startProxyCommand, type ProxyTarget } from './proxy-command.ts'\n\n/** Default engine knobs. */\nexport interface EngineOptions {\n  /** Connections idle longer than this are closed (ms). */\n  idleTimeoutMs?: number\n  /**\n   * Ceiling for the whole pre-ready sequence (ms): TCP connect, SSH key\n   * exchange and user authentication. Passed to ssh2's `readyTimeout`.\n   */\n  connectTimeoutMs?: number\n  /** Keepalive ping interval (ms). */\n  keepaliveIntervalMs?: number\n  /** Cap on captured stdout/stderr bytes per exec (ms). */\n  maxOutputBytes?: number\n  /** Default exec timeout (ms). */\n  defaultExecTimeoutMs?: number\n  /** Default cluster concurrency. */\n  defaultMaxWorkers?: number\n  /** SFTP concurrent channel count for transfers. */\n  sftpConcurrency?: number\n}\n\n/**\n * Default ceiling for TCP connect, SSH key exchange and user authentication\n * together (ms). Password authentication behind PAM / LDAP can outlast the\n * previous 15 s ceiling while the server still eventually accepts it.\n */\nexport const DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000\n\n/** Default engine knobs (applied when an option is omitted). */\nexport const DEFAULTS: Required<EngineOptions> = {\n  idleTimeoutMs: 30 * 60_000,\n  connectTimeoutMs: DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS,\n  keepaliveIntervalMs: 15_000,\n  maxOutputBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,\n  defaultExecTimeoutMs: 60_000,\n  defaultMaxWorkers: 8,\n  sftpConcurrency: 8,\n}\n\n/** One pooled connection record. */\nexport interface PoolRecord {\n  client: Client\n  /** Jump-chain clients kept alive under the target. */\n  hops: Client[]\n  idleAt: number\n  /** Pinned connections (tunnels) are never swept. */\n  pinned: boolean\n  broken: boolean\n  /** Operations currently running on this connection (sweep guard). */\n  inFlight: number\n}\n\n/**\n * The slice of the engine the pool and exec paths need. The host class\n * (engine.ts facade) satisfies this structurally.\n */\nexport interface PoolEngine {\n  readonly store: HostStore\n  readonly opts: Required<EngineOptions>\n  readonly pool: Map<string, PoolRecord>\n  readonly acquireQueue: Map<string, Promise<PoolRecord>>\n}\n\n/** Build the ssh2 connect config for one entry (key read from disk). */\nexport function buildConnectConfig(entry: SshHostEntry, sock: ConnectConfig['sock'] | undefined, opts: Required<EngineOptions>): ConnectConfig {\n  const config: ConnectConfig = {\n    host: entry.host,\n    port: entry.port,\n    username: entry.user,\n    readyTimeout: opts.connectTimeoutMs,\n    keepaliveInterval: opts.keepaliveIntervalMs,\n    keepaliveCountMax: 3,\n    tryKeyboard: true,\n  }\n  if (sock !== undefined) config.sock = sock\n  if (entry.auth.kind === 'password') {\n    config.password = entry.auth.password\n  } else if (entry.auth.kind === 'agent') {\n    const agentPath = resolveAgentPath(entry.auth.agentPath)\n    if (agentPath === undefined) {\n      throw new Error('ssh-agent is not available: set SSH_AUTH_SOCK or configure an agent path (use \\'pageant\\' for PuTTY Pageant on Windows)')\n    }\n    config.agent = agentPath\n  } else {\n    const keyPath = entry.auth.keyPath === undefined ? undefined : expandHome(entry.auth.keyPath)\n    if (keyPath === undefined || !existsSync(keyPath)) {\n      throw new Error('private key not found: ' + (entry.auth.keyPath ?? '(unset)'))\n    }\n    config.privateKey = readFileSync(keyPath, 'utf8')\n    if (entry.auth.passphrase !== undefined && entry.auth.passphrase !== '') {\n      config.passphrase = entry.auth.passphrase\n    }\n  }\n  // Agent forwarding is additive: it never changes how the host\n  // authenticates, it only lets this connection broker signatures from the\n  // local agent for the remote side (OpenSSH ForwardAgent / ssh -A).\n  if (entry.forwardAgent === true) {\n    // Agent auth already resolved an endpoint, and reusing it keeps the\n    // forwarded agent identical to the one that authenticated.\n    const agentPath = typeof config.agent === 'string'\n      ? config.agent\n      : resolveForwardAgentPath(entry.auth.agentPath)\n    if (agentPath === undefined) {\n      // ssh2's own message for this case (\"You must set a valid agent path to\n      // allow agent forwarding\") names neither the host nor a way out, so the\n      // engine refuses first with an actionable one.\n      throw new Error('agent forwarding is enabled for this host but no ssh-agent endpoint is available: '\n        + 'set SSH_AUTH_SOCK, start Pageant on Windows, or configure an agent path')\n    }\n    config.agent = agentPath\n    config.agentForward = true\n  }\n  return config\n}\n\n/**\n * The default ssh-agent endpoint on Windows: the named pipe the native\n * OpenSSH ssh-agent service listens on. ssh2 connects to a named pipe for any\n * path matching its Windows pipe form, so the default is a real endpoint\n * rather than a protocol name (#1910). PuTTY Pageant is still reachable — it\n * is what the literal `pageant` agent path selects — but it is no longer the\n * assumption.\n */\nexport const WINDOWS_AGENT_PIPE = '\\\\\\\\.\\\\pipe\\\\openssh-ssh-agent'\n\n/** Resolve the ssh2 agent path for 'agent' auth. */\nexport function resolveAgentPath(agentPath?: string): string | undefined {\n  const explicit = normalizeAgentPath(agentPath)\n  if (explicit !== undefined) return explicit\n  const sock = process.env.SSH_AUTH_SOCK\n  if (sock !== undefined && sock !== '') return sock\n  if (process.platform === 'win32') return WINDOWS_AGENT_PIPE\n  return undefined\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolve the ssh-agent endpoint that forwarding brokers signatures through:\n * an explicitly configured agent path wins, then SSH_AUTH_SOCK, then the\n * native OpenSSH named pipe on Windows. ' after ' + timeoutMs + ' ms' : ''\n  const hint = ' - raise the dsh-ssh connectTimeoutMs setting if this host is slow'\n  return handshakeComplete\n    ? 'SSH authentication timed out' + budget + ': TCP connect and key exchange completed, but the server did not finish authenticating the user' + hint\n    : 'SSH connection timed out' + budget + ' before key exchange completed: TCP connect or the SSH key exchange did not finish' + hint\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether ssh2 ended the attempt with its pre-ready timeout. as Error & { level?: unknown }).level === 'client-timeout'\n}\n\n/** Connect one ssh2 client (resolve on ready, reject on error/close). */\nexport function connectClient(config: ConnectConfig, onKeyboardInteractive?: KeyboardInteractiveHandler): Promise<Client> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const client = new Client()\n    let settled = false\n    // Key exchange completion is the only public phase boundary ssh2 exposes\n    // between \"TCP connect / SSH handshake\" and \"user authentication\".\n    let handshakeComplete = false\n    const fail = (error:       "content": "/**\n * PTY shell sessions for the web terminal: a standalone (non-pooled)\n * ssh2 connection with a long-lived shell channel, resize, and pausable\n * output delivery.\n */\n\nimport { connectChain, type KeyboardInteractiveHandler, type PoolEngine } from './connection-pool.ts'\n\n/** A live PTY shell session. */\nexport interface ShellSession {\n  /** Assign to receive remote output. */\n  onData?: (data: Buffer) => void\n  /** Assign to be notified when the channel closes. */\n  onExit?: (code: number | null, error?: string) => void\n  /** Write raw input to the shell. */\n  send(data: string): void\n  /** Resize the remote PTY. */\n  resize(cols: number, rows: number): void\n  /** Close the session and its channel. */\n  close(): void\n  /** Pause remote output delivery (transport backpressure). */\n  pause(): void\n  /** Resume remote output delivery. */\n  resume(): void\n}\n\n/**\n * Open a PTY shell session for the web terminal (standalone connection).\n * The shell is a long-lived exclusive stream: it uses its own connection so\n * closing it can never tear down a pooled exec/tunnel sharing the alias.\n */\nexport async function openShell(\n  engine: PoolEngine,\n  alias: string,\n  size: { cols: number; rows: number },\n  onKeyboardInteractive?: KeyboardInteractiveHandler,\n): Promise<ShellSession> {\n  const entry = engine.store.find(alias)\n  if (entry === undefined) throw new Error('alias \\'' + alias + '\\' not found — add it first')\n  const { client, hops } = await connectChain(engine, entry, onKeyboardInteractive)\n  return await new Promise<ShellSession>((resolve, reject) => {\n    client.shell({ term: 'xterm-256color', cols: size.cols, rows: size.rows }, (error, stream) => {\n      if (error !== undefined) {\n        try { client.end() } catch { /* closed */ }\n        for (const hop of hops) { try { hop.end() } catch { /* closed */ } }\n        reject(error)\n        return\n      }\n      let tornDown = false\n      const teardown = (): void => {\n        if (tornDown) return\n        tornDown = true\n        try { client.end() } catch { /* closed */ }\n        for (const hop of hops) { try { hop.end() } catch { /* closed */ } }\n      }\n      const session: ShellSession = {\n        send: (data) => { try { stream.write(data) } catch { /* channel gone */ } },\n        resize: (cols, rows) => { try { stream.setWindow(rows, cols, rows, cols) } catch { /* channel gone */ } },\n        close: () => {\n          try { stream.close() } catch { /* channel gone */ }\n          teardown()\n        },\n        pause: () => { try { stream.pause() } catch { /* channel gone */ } },\n        resume: () => { try { stream.resume() } catch { /* channel gone */ } },\n      }\n      stream.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => { session.onData?.(chunk) })\n      stream.on('close', (code: number | null) => {\n        teardown()\n        session.onExit?.(code)\n      })\n      stream.on('error', (streamError: Error) => {\n        teardown()\n        session.onExit?.(null, streamError instanceof Error ? streamError.message : String(streamError))\n      })\n      resolve(session)\n    })\n  })\n}"

      "path": "packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/sftp.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * SFTP transfers: upload (file or recursive tree), single-file download, and\n * remote directory listing. Every channel is opened once per operation and\n * released exactly once so sshd's MaxSessions cap is never exhausted.\n */\n\nimport { existsSync, lstatSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { dirname, join, relative, resolve as resolvePath } from 'node:path'\nimport { Client, type SFTPWrapper } from 'ssh2'\nimport type { RemoteDirEntry, TransferProgress } from '../protocol.ts'\nimport { withClient, type PoolEngine } from './connection-pool.ts'\n\n/** Walk a local directory, collecting relative paths of every file. */\nexport function walkLocalDir(root: string): string[] {\n  const files: string[] = []\n  const visit = (dir: string): void => {\n    for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {\n      const full = join(dir, name)\n      // lstat, not stat: a symlink must never be followed — a link cycle\n      // (ln -s . self) recurses forever under stat, and a link to a file\n      // would silently upload the target's bytes.\n      const stat = lstatSync(full)\n      if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) continue\n      if (stat.isDirectory()) visit(full)\n      else if (stat.isFile()) files.push(relative(root, full).replaceAll('\\\\', '/'))\n    }\n  }\n  visit(root)\n  return files\n}\n\n/** Upload one local file (or directory tree) to a remote path. */\nexport async function upload(\n  engine: PoolEngine,\n  alias: string,\n  localPath: string,\n  remotePath: string,\n  recursive: boolean,\n  onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void,\n): Promise<{ bytes: number; files: number }> {\n  // Remote paths must be absolute: the mkdir chain and fastPut must agree\n  // on one resolution (relative paths previously created dirs at the root).\n  if (!remotePath.startsWith('/')) {\n    throw new Error('remotePath must be an absolute path (got \\'' + remotePath + '\\')')\n  }\n  const local = resolvePath(localPath)\n  if (!existsSync(local)) throw new Error('local path not found: \\'' + localPath + '\\'')\n  return withClient(engine, alias, (client) => withSftp(client, async (sftp) => {\n    const stat = statSync(local)\n    let files: string[]\n    if (stat.isDirectory()) {\n      if (!recursive) throw new Error('\\'' + localPath + '\\' is a directory — enable recursive upload')\n      files = walkLocalDir(local)\n      await ensureRemoteDir(sftp, remotePath)\n    } else {\n      files = ['']\n      await ensureRemoteDir(sftp, dirname(remotePath))\n    }\n    let bytes = 0\n    for (const rel of files) {\n      const src = rel === '' ? local : join(local, rel)\n      // Remote paths always use forward slashes; normalize any OS separators.\n      const remoteRel = rel.split(/[\\\\/]/).join('/')\n      const dst = rel === '' ? remotePath : remotePath.replace(/\\/$/, '') + '/' + remoteRel\n      await fastPut(sftp, src, dst, engine.opts.sftpConcurrency, onProgress)\n      bytes += statSync(src).size\n    }\n    return { bytes, files: files.length }\n  }))\n}\n\n/** Download one remote file to a local path. */\nexport async function download(\n  engine: PoolEngine,\n  alias: string,\n  remotePath: string,\n  localPath: string,\n  onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void,\n): Promise<{ bytes: number }> {\n  return withClient(engine, alias, (client) => withSftp(client, async (sftp) => {\n    const stat = await new Promise<{ isDirectory: () => boolean }>((resolve, reject) => {\n      sftp.stat(remotePath, (error, stats) => error !== undefined ? reject(error) : resolve(stats))\n    })\n    if (stat.isDirectory()) {\n      throw new Error('\\'' + remotePath + '\\' is a directory — directory download is not supported yet (download individual files)')\n    }\n    const local = resolvePath(localPath)\n    if (!existsSync(dirname(local))) mkdirSync(dirname(local), { recursive: true })\n    await fastGet(sftp, remotePath, local, engine.opts.sftpConcurrency, onProgress)\n    return { bytes: statSync(local).size }\n  }))\n}\n\n/** List a remote directory (file browser). */\nexport async function ls(engine: PoolEngine, alias: string, path: string): Promise<RemoteDirEntry[]> {\n  return withClient(engine, alias, (client) => withSftp(client, async (sftp) => {\n    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      sftp.readdir(path, (error, list) => {\n        if (error !== undefined) {\n          reject(error)\n          return\n        }\n        const entries: RemoteDirEntry[] = list.map(item => ({\n          name: item.filename,\n          type: item.attrs.isDirectory() ? 'dir' : item.attrs.isFile() ? 'file' : 'other',\n          size: item.attrs.size,\n          mtimeMs: item.attrs.mtime * 1000,\n          mode: item.attrs.mode,\n        }))\n        resolve(entries)\n      })\n    })\n  }))\n}\n\n/**\n * Open one SFTP channel, run the operation, and release the channel exactly\n * once when the operation settles (success or error). ssh2 keeps each\n * subsystem channel open until end(); without this, every transfer leaks a\n * channel until sshd's MaxSessions cap makes all later opens fail.\n */\nasync function withSftp<T>(client: Client, run: (sftp: SFTPWrapper) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {\n  const sftp = await sftpChannel(client)\n  let ended = false\n  const endOnce = (): void => {\n    if (ended) return\n    ended = true\n    try { sftp.end() } catch { /* channel already closed */ }\n  }\n  // The channel can also close underneath us (peer reset, timeout); the\n  // guard makes the finally below a no-op instead of ending it twice.\n  sftp.once('close', endOnce)\n  try {\n    return await run(sftp)\n  } finally {\n    endOnce()\n  }\n}\n\nfunction sftpChannel(client: Client): Promise<SFTPWrapper> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    client.sftp((error, sftp) => error !== undefined ? reject(error) : resolve(sftp))\n  })\n}\n\n/** Create a remote directory chain (stat-then-mkdir per segment). */\nfunction ensureRemoteDir(sftp: SFTPWrapper, remote: string): Promise<void> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const segments = remote.replace(/^\\/+/, '').split('/').filter(segment => segment !== '')\n    const walk = (index: number): void => {\n      if (index >= segments.length) {\n        resolve()\n        return\n      }\n      const current = '/' + segments.slice(0, index + 1).join('/')\n      sftp.stat(current, (statError) => {\n        if (statError === undefined) {\n          walk(index + 1)\n          return\n        }\n        // Statting a missing path fails; mkdir it (idempotent because the\n        // stat check runs first — some sftp servers throw on EEXIST).\n        sftp.mkdir(current, (mkdirError) => {\n          if (mkdirError !== undefined) {\n            reject(mkdirError)\n            return\n          }\n          walk(index + 1)\n        })\n      })\n    }\n    walk(0)\n  })\n}\n\n/** One fastPut/fastGet transfer with throttled progress (the two directions share everything but the verb). */\nfunction fastTransfer(sftp: SFTPWrapper, kind: 'put' | 'get', src: string, dst: string, concurrency: number, onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void): Promise<void> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    // Progress frames name the destination on upload, the source on download;\n    // the final size comes from the local side of the transfer.\n    const file = kind === 'put' ? dst : src\n    const finalSize = (): number => statSync(kind === 'put' ? src : dst).size\n    let last = 0\n    let lastEmit = 0\n    const started = Date.now()\n    if (kind === 'put') {\n      onProgress?.({ phase: 'transferring', file, transferred: 0, total: statSync(src).size, percent: 0 })\n    }\n    const step = (transferred: number, _chunk: number, total: number): void => {\n      const now = Date.now()\n      // Throttle: high-speed links fire one callback per chunk; the UI only\n      // needs ~10 frames per second.\n      if (now - lastEmit < 100 && transferred < total) return\n      lastEmit = now\n      const elapsed = (now - started) / 1000\n      onProgress?.({\n        phase: 'transferring',\n        file,\n        transferred,\n        total,\n        percent: total > 0 ? Math.round((transferred / total) * 1000) / 10 : 0,\n        speedBps: elapsed > 0 ? Math.round((transferred - last) / elapsed) : undefined,\n      })\n      last = transferred\n    }\n    const done = (error: unknown): void => {\n      if (error !== undefined) {\n        onProgress?.({ phase: 'error', file, transferred: 0, total: 0, percent: 0, error: String(error) })\n        reject(error)\n      } else {\n        onProgress?.({ phase: 'done', file, transferred: finalSize(), total: finalSize(), percent: 100 })\n        resolve()\n      }\n    }\n    if (kind === 'put') sftp.fastPut(src, dst, { concurrency, step }, done)\n    else sftp.fastGet(src, dst, { concurrency, step }, done)\n  })\n}\n\nfunction fastPut(sftp: SFTPWrapper, src: string, dst: string, concurrency: number, onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void): Promise<void> {\n  return fastTransfer(sftp, 'put', src, dst, concurrency, onProgress)\n}\n\nfunction fastGet(sftp: SFTPWrapper, src: string, dst: string, concurrency: number, onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void): Promise<void> {\n  return fastTransfer(sftp, 'get', src, dst, concurrency, onProgress)\n}"

      "path": "packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/terminal-sessions.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Host-side terminal sessions for the web terminal.\n *\n * The PTY shell is owned here, not by the browser view: a view can detach\n * (panel switch, page unmount, a dropped socket) and reattach by session id\n * without tearing the remote shell down, which is what makes the terminal\n * survival property the old DOM takeover used to provide. A session with no\n * attached socket is reaped after an idle window, and an exited one is kept\n * for a short grace window so a reattaching view still sees the final screen.\n */\nimport { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { WebSocket } from 'ws'\nimport type { KeyboardInteractiveHandler } from './connection-pool.ts'\nimport type { ShellSession } from './pty.ts'\nimport type { TerminalServerFrame } from '../protocol.ts'\n\n/** Pause the shell when an attached socket's send buffer exceeds this… */\nconst BACKPRESSURE_HIGH_WATER = 1024 * 1024\n\n/** …and resume once every attached socket drains below this. */\nconst BACKPRESSURE_LOW_WATER = 512 * 1024\n\n/** Scrollback retained for a reattaching view (bytes of UTF-8 output). */\nconst DEFAULT_MAX_BUFFER_BYTES = 256 * 1024\n\n/** A detached session is reaped after this long. */\nconst DEFAULT_IDLE_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000\n\n/** An exited session is kept this long for a reattaching view. */\nconst DEFAULT_EXIT_GRACE_MS = 60 * 1000\n\n/** One live terminal session and the sockets currently watching it. */\ninterface HostedTerminal {\n  id: string\n  alias: string\n  shell?: ShellSession\n  sockets: Set<WebSocket>\n  /** Bounded scrollback replayed to an attaching socket. */\n  buffer: string[]\n  bufferBytes: number\n  exited: boolean\n  exit?: { code: number | null; error?: string }\n  /** Pending keyboard-interactive challenge, whoever attached when it arrived. */\n  pendingAuthFinish?: (responses: string[]) => void\n  reapTimer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>\n}\n\n/** What the registry needs from the engine (swappable in tests). */\nexport interface TerminalSessionDeps {\n  /** Open one PTY shell for the alias (engine.openShell). */\n  openShell(alias: string, size: { cols: number; rows: number }, onKeyboardInteractive?: KeyboardInteractiveHandler): Promise<ShellSession>\n  /** @returns the current time (defaults to Date.now). */\n  now?: () => number\n  /** Bounded scrollback per session. */\n  maxBufferBytes?: number\n  /** Idle window before a detached session is reaped. */\n  idleMs?: number\n  /** Grace window an exited session is kept for reattaching views. */\n  exitGraceMs?: number\n}\n\n/**\n * The host's terminal session table: open one session per connect, attach any\n * number of sockets, and keep the shell alive across detach.\n */\nexport class TerminalSessionRegistry {\n  private readonly sessions = new Map<string, HostedTerminal>()\n  private readonly deps: TerminalSessionDeps\n  private readonly maxBufferBytes: number\n  private readonly idleMs: number\n  private readonly exitGraceMs: number\n\n  constructor(deps: TerminalSessionDeps) {\n    this.deps = deps\n    this.maxBufferBytes = deps.maxBufferBytes ?? DEFAULT_MAX_BUFFER_BYTES\n    this.idleMs = deps.idleMs ?? DEFAULT_IDLE_MS\n    this.exitGraceMs = deps.exitGraceMs ?? DEFAULT_EXIT_GRACE_MS\n  }\n\n  /** Open a new session for the alias and attach the requesting socket to it. */\n  async open(ws: WebSocket, alias: string, size: { cols: number; rows: number }): Promise<void> {\n    const session: HostedTerminal = {\n      id: randomBytes(9).toString('hex'),\n      alias,\n      sockets: new Set(),\n      buffer: [],\n      bufferBytes: 0,\n      exited: false,\n    }\n    this.sessions.set(session.id, session)\n    this.bind(ws, session)\n    try {\n      const shell = await this.deps.openShell(alias, size, this.keyboardInteractive(session))\n      if (!this.sessions.has(session.id)) {\n        // The session was ended (or the host torn down) while it connected.\n        shell.close()\n        return\n      }\n      session.shell = shell\n      shell.onData = data => { this.pushOutput(session, data.toString('utf8')) }\n      shell.onExit = (code, error) => { this.finish(session, code, error) }\n      this.send(session, { type: 'ready', alias, sessionId: session.id })\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.sessions.delete(session.id)\n      this.send(session, { type: 'exit', code: null, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Attach a socket to an existing session, replaying its scrollback first.\n   * @returns false when the session is unknown (expired or already reaped).\n   */\n  attach(ws: WebSocket, sessionId: string, size: { cols: number; rows: number }): boolean {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId)\n    if (session === undefined) return false\n    this.bind(ws, session)\n    this.clearReap(session)\n    for (const chunk of session.buffer) this.sendTo(session, ws, { type: 'output', data: chunk })\n    this.sendTo(session, ws, { type: 'ready', alias: session.alias, sessionId: session.id })\n    if (session.exited) {\n      this.sendTo(session, ws, { type: 'exit', code: session.exit?.code ?? null, error: session.exit?.error })\n      // Re-arm the grace window: this socket now holds the exited session open.\n      this.scheduleReap(session, this.exitGraceMs)\n    } else {\n      session.shell?.resize(Math.max(2, size.cols), Math.max(1, size.rows))\n      session.shell?.resume()\n    }\n    return true\n  }\n\n  /** End every session (host teardown, plugin dispose). */\n  dispose(): void {\n    for (const session of [...this.sessions.values()]) this.end(session, false)\n    this.sessions.clear()\n  }\n\n  /** Number of live sessions (introspection for tests and diagnostics). */\n  size(): number {\n    return this.sessions.size\n  }\n\n  /** Wire one socket's frames and lifecycle onto a session. */\n  private bind(ws: WebSocket, session: HostedTerminal): void {\n    session.sockets.add(ws)\n    ws.on('message', (data) => {\n      let frame: { type?: string; data?: string; cols?: number; rows?: number; responses?: string[] }\n      try {\n        frame = JSON.parse(String(data)) as typeof frame\n      } catch {\n        return\n      }\n      if (frame.type === 'input') {\n        session.shell?.send(frame.data ?? '')\n      } else if (frame.type === 'resize') {\n        session.shell?.resize(Math.max(2, frame.cols ?? 80), Math.max(1, frame.rows ?? 24))\n      } else if (frame.type === 'auth_response') {\n        const finish = session.pendingAuthFinish\n        session.pendingAuthFinish = undefined\n        try { finish?.(frame.responses ?? []) } catch { /* the connect already failed */ }\n      } else if (frame.type === 'close') {\n        this.end(session, true)\n      } else if (frame.type === 'detach') {\n        this.detach(ws)\n      }\n    })\n    ws.on('close', () => { this.detach(ws) })\n    ws.on('error', () => { this.detach(ws) })\n  }\n\n  /** Remove a socket from its session, keeping the shell alive. */\n  private detach(ws: WebSocket): void {\n    for (const session of this.sessions.values()) {\n      if (!session.sockets.delete(ws)) continue\n      if (session.sockets.size === 0) {\n        // Nobody is watching: give the view a window to come back before the\n        // remote shell is torn down (or, for an exited one, before its final\n        // screen is dropped).\n        this.scheduleReap(session, session.exited ? this.exitGraceMs : this.idleMs)\n      }\n      return\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** End the session a socket is attached to (explicit close from the view). */\n  private end(session: HostedTerminal, notify: boolean): void {\n    this.clearReap(session)\n    if (this.sessions.delete(session.id) && notify) {\n      if (session.pendingAuthFinish !== undefined) {\n        const finish = session.pendingAuthFinish\n        session.pendingAuthFinish = undefined\n        try { finish([]) } catch { /* the connect already failed */ }\n      }\n    }\n    try { session.shell?.close() } catch { /* channel gone */ }\n  }\n\n  /** Mark a session exited and keep it briefly so a reattaching view sees it. */\n  private finish(session: HostedTerminal, code: number | null, error?: string): void {\n    if (session.exited) return\n    session.exited = true\n    session.exit = { code, error }\n    this.send(session, { type: 'exit', code, error })\n    // The view has its exit frame; close the sockets so neither the browser\n    // nor the host holds a dead transport open. The session record itself\n    // survives the grace window, so a reattach still replays the final screen.\n    for (const ws of [...session.sockets]) {\n      session.sockets.delete(ws)\n      try { ws.close(1000) } catch { /* already closed */ }\n    }\n    this.scheduleReap(session, this.exitGraceMs)\n  }\n\n  /** Append output to the replay buffer, trimmed to the byte cap. */\n  private pushOutput(session: HostedTerminal, data: string): void {\n    session.buffer.push(data)\n    session.bufferBytes += Buffer.byteLength(data)\n    while (session.bufferBytes > this.maxBufferBytes && session.buffer.length > 1) {\n      const dropped = session.buffer.shift()\n      session.bufferBytes -= Buffer.byteLength(dropped ?? '')\n    }\n    this.send(session, { type: 'output', data })\n  }\n\n  /** Broadcast one frame to every attached socket, honoring backpressure. */\n  private send(session: HostedTerminal, frame: TerminalServerFrame): void {\n    for (const ws of session.sockets) this.sendTo(session, ws, frame)\n    this.applyBackpressure(session)\n  }\n\n  private sendTo(session: HostedTerminal, ws: WebSocket, frame: TerminalServerFrame): void {\n    if (ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return\n    try { ws.send(JSON.stringify(frame)) } catch { /* socket raced away */ }\n  }\n\n  /** Pause while any attached socket is backed up; resume once all drained. */\n  private applyBackpressure(session: HostedTerminal): void {\n    const shell = session.shell\n    if (shell === undefined) return\n    let high = false\n    let low = true\n    for (const ws of session.sockets) {\n      if (ws.bufferedAmount > BACKPRESSURE_HIGH_WATER) high = true\n      if (ws.bufferedAmount > BACKPRESSURE_LOW_WATER) low = false\n    }\n    if (high) shell.pause()\n    else if (low) shell.resume()\n  }\n\n  /** Answer a keyboard-interactive challenge through whoever is attached. */\n  private keyboardInteractive(session: HostedTerminal): KeyboardInteractiveHandler {\n    return (name, instructions, _lang, prompts, finish) => {\n      session.pendingAuthFinish = finish\n      this.send(session, {\n        type: 'auth_prompt',\n        name,\n        instructions,\n        prompts: prompts.map(p => ({ prompt: p.prompt, echo: p.echo })),\n      })\n    }\n  }\n\n  private scheduleReap(session: HostedTerminal, delayMs: number): void {\n    this.clearReap(session)\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => {\n      session.reapTimer = undefined\n      if (session.sockets.size > 0) return\n      this.end(session, false)\n    }, delayMs)\n    // Never hold the host process open for an idle terminal.\n    ;(timer as { unref?: () => void }).unref?.()\n    session.reapTimer = timer\n  }\n\n  private clearReap(session: HostedTerminal): void {\n    if (session.reapTimer !== undefined) {\n      clearTimeout(session.reapTimer)\n      session.reapTimer = undefined\n    }\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/tunnel.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Local port-forward tunnels: one loopback-only listener per tunnel, pinned\n * to a pooled connection so an idle sweep never closes it, with per-tunnel\n * socket tracking and stop (single / alias-scoped / all).\n */\n\nimport { createServer, type Server as NetServer, type Socket } from 'node:net'\nimport type { TunnelInfo } from '../protocol.ts'\nimport { acquire, disposeRecord, endRecordChain, type PoolEngine, type PoolRecord } from './connection-pool.ts'\n\n/** One active tunnel record (server + pinned connection + live sockets). */\nexport interface TunnelRecord {\n  info: TunnelInfo\n  server: NetServer\n  alias: string\n  /** The pooled connection this tunnel pins; siblings on one alias may share it. */\n  record: PoolRecord\n  sockets: Set<Socket>\n  /** Detach the link-death hook startTunnel installs on the pooled client. */\n  detachLink?: () => void\n}\n\n/** The engine slice the tunnel module needs (adds the tunnel registry). */\nexport interface TunnelEngine extends PoolEngine {\n  readonly tunnels: Map<string, TunnelRecord>\n  nextTunnelId: number\n}\n\n/** Destroy one socket or channel stream, tolerating an already-dead peer. */\nfunction destroyQuietly(target: { destroy(): void }): void {\n  try { target.destroy() } catch { /* already closed */ }\n}\n\n/**\n * Tear down one tunnel because the SSH link behind it is gone. '127.0.0.1'\n  const id = 'tun-' + engine.nextTunnelId\n  engine.nextTunnelId += 1\n  const info: TunnelInfo = {\n    id,\n    alias,\n    localPort: 0,\n    remoteHost,\n    remotePort: options.remotePort,\n    state: 'connecting',\n    startedAt: Date.now(),\n  }\n  // Reuse the live pooled connection when one exists so sibling tunnels on\n  // one alias multiplex over it (and no orphaned connection leaks); recycle\n  // a broken one first.\n  const existing = engine.pool.get(alias)\n  if (existing !== undefined && existing.broken) disposeRecord(engine, alias, existing)\n  const record = engine.pool.get(alias) ??
